semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Checked at provider level; seeded exampleRoutes also required
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Match explicit product IDs; provider availability and authorisation gate separate.

semanticAuditMappings.provider_fields: one bank product + one merchant product
semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Union of currencies is ANDed against all offers
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Bank requirements evaluated against one eligible bank offer; merchant requirements against one eligible merchant offer; show bundle and separate providers explicitly.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Every offer must pass; wrong AND across alternatives
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: OR across product alternatives, AND across criteria within selected product.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Identity used for case/client identity; not suitability
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Keep verified client identity separate from matching; registration+jurisdiction stable key; email alone not personal identity.
Apply provider entity-form matrix; unknown needs confirmation; other form mapped to reviewed canonical form.
Evaluate ISO jurisdiction against current approved product policy; no fallback to seed support.
Keep residence independent of nationality and tax residence.
Evaluate every declared applicant nationality; never substitute UBO axes.
Evaluate all declared tax-residence jurisdictions separately; missing relevant policy remains unknown.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Checked for captured structured owners only
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Apply every relevant natural person nationality; control-based owners need same structured representation.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Checked for structured owners if nonempty
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Validate country from list; empty is incomplete not omission; controllers require structured residence.
Apply corporate-shareholder jurisdictions and multilayer legal-owner appetite.

semanticAuditMappings.provider_fields: risk complex ownership; listed companies; entities
semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored by matcher; generic 75%-100% intake rule
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Collect ownership/control facts without universal 75% floor. Resolve actual governing-law beneficial owners; ownership percentages not a universal compliance gate.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored; listed-Yes suppresses UBO and bypasses owner entry
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Require verified eligible exchange/disclosure treatment before exemption; public limited form alone is not listing/exemption.

semanticAuditMappings.provider_fields: risk Groups seeking several accounts; separate product/client eligibility
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Each group applicant evaluated separately; essential group acceptance conditions affect eligibility, preference affects rank only.
If required, linked personal profile required; do not assume from institution family alone.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Exact name index checked if known; unknown label bypasses
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Use shared stable IDs; unresolved Other reviewed; no silent unsupported industry bypass.

semanticAuditMappings.provider_fields: industry conditions; risk conditions; permitted product scope
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Classify against shared industry taxonomy and provider scope with evidence; unresolved classification pending, not exact-fit.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Not connected; capture FI website incorrectly uses hidden #website
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Use route-specific website/activity; evidence-backed website comparison internal DD, unresolved mismatch holds introduction.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored; Yes preselected in base UI
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Separate sector classification from jurisdictional authorisation; verify licence holder, authority, jurisdiction, scope and current status; do not default factual licence response Yes.
Evaluate both entities and licensed activity; substitute applicant only through explicit verified legal arrangement.
Convert Yes/No + actual operating country to office-policy predicate; registered address not staffed office.
Map 0 versus >=1 reliably; case-by-case stays conditional.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored by suitability matcher; no live screening
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Keep legal restrictions first; PEP conditional enhanced diligence, not blanket rejection. Match risk appetite after legal gate.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Only currencies treated as all essential; preferences ignored
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Attach essential/preferred per selected need; hard predicates cannot be relaxed by high score; unknown never counted as supported.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Partially checked; Other provider not normalized; merchant settlement currencies excluded
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Normalize ISO 4217 per account purpose; parse explicit Other codes on both sides; keep financing/charge/settlement/account currencies separate.

semanticAuditMappings.applicant_fields: fi-features SEPA/SEPA Instant; bank no explicit rail question
semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored; applicant rail requirement largely missing
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Ask relevant requested rails only; retain rail IDs SWIFT/SEPA/T2/ACH/wire/FasterPayments/OpenBanking separately from currencies.

semanticAuditMappings.applicant_fields: FI VIBAN feature; no general IBAN-country requirement
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Use distinct dedicated account IBAN versus virtual IBAN issuance; optional preference only unless essential.
Ask only if in-person attendance or documents materially affects client; show terms for informed choice.

semanticAuditMappings.applicant_fields: finance-timeline; other routes no timing request
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Timeline preference uses realistic SLA conditional from complete file, not account approval promise.
Shared language codes; private optional preference weighted; other roles not asked unless needed.
Keep commercial terms/ratings outside eligibility and fit; no commission-driven ranking.
Map shared purpose IDs; operating account required where selected.
Preferences do not guarantee acceptance or permit prohibited activity.
Match legal escrow capability and conditional thresholds.
Bank facility versus financing product distinguished.
Match supported countries/rails and limits.
Match issuer-country/residency/limits if constrained.
Multi-currency does not alone prove FX capability.
Product term/minimum captured if minimum required.
Unclassified request pending clarification.
Preference, never unsubstantiated better-rate guarantee.
Expand region shorthand into member ISO countries; all required corridors pass.
Do not substitute incorporation/UBO country for destination corridor.
Numeric limits checked with dated FX conversion if needed; zero handled logically.
Numeric limits checked; explain unknown versus unlimited.
Add conditional maximum single transfer only when provider limits require it.
Add minimal amount-to-hold field if client cannot meet required balance.
Do not claim a bank account for EMI/payment product; explicit model choice and safeguarding/protection disclosure.
Context only unless lender/refinancing/settlement compatibility relevant.

semanticAuditMappings.provider_fields: No direct provider matcher field; screening scope
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: All named parties normalized into entity/person screening subjects, not anonymous note; optional absence not cleared.
Select each required channel; terminal country/capability conditional.

semanticAuditMappings.provider_fields: risk Third-party funds; no structured marketplace model
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Introduce structured merchant-of-record/marketplace/aggregator capability; no false ordinary merchant fit.
Normalize supported integrations; if mandatory exclude unsupported; optional preference rank only.
Conditional POS delivery country/model and inventory terms.
Structured delivery bands only if acceptance depends on delayed fulfillment.
Use weighted exposure/conditional per-country share constraints; not just country array.
Amounts and counts separated; absent count maximum explicitly unconstrained.
Use same metric/basis and currency; largest ticket essential when provider caps.
Exact availabilityMonths + startup status; Yes to six months insufficient for required12.
Context only, optional; no infer support from brand name.
Compare only same denominator and observation period; unknown means not assessed, not0.
Different provider definitions require normalization; keep concise field helper.

semanticAuditMappings.provider_fields: No fixed-price data; risk assessed pricing
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Soft budget request only, never exact fit or pricing promise.
Normalize shared IDs + required/preferred tags; free text unconfirmed.

semanticAuditMappings.criterion: Crypto on/off-ramp, crypto payments, crypto settlement
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Shared explicit service IDs and chain/asset/country constraints; licences/screening first.
Independent from charge currencies; current bridge excludes them.
Evaluate settlement country/currency and account holder; requesting bank auto activates bank flow.
Show as product conditions with optional must-have limits; never silently score.
Ask minimal required schemes if broad acceptance not enough; other scheme mapping.

semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Shared product IDs; Other unresolved; optional/essential investor preferences.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored; initial placement only checks seed minDeposit

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored; initial placement only checks seed minDeposit

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored; initial placement only checks seed minDeposit

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored; initial placement only checks seed minDeposit

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored; initial placement only checks seed minDeposit

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored; initial placement only checks seed minDeposit

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored; initial placement only checks seed minDeposit

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored; initial placement only checks seed minDeposit

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored; initial placement only checks seed minDeposit

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored except generic currency family gate

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Ignored except generic currency family gate

Capability/evidence policy, No cannot support required controls.
Evidence requirements and freshness actual documented outcomes, not uncheckedyes.
Structured internal/external/noMLRO/location provider rules.
Registration jurisdiction distinct from applicant incorporation; apply country-specific requirements.

semanticAuditMappings.provider_fields: No dedicated MiCA status acceptance matrix; licenceConditions
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Jurisdictional crypto regime / authorisation / Article60 status separate structured predicates.

semanticAuditMappings.provider_fields: No dedicated CASP service/asset/chain support; complianceConditions
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Structured scope and permitted service mapping.
Provider-specific acceptance and controls; not automatic unlawful assumption.
Record applicability/implemented control evidence; legal obligations jurisdiction-specific.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: validateAll excludes removed step4 axis completeness check
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Validate required axes in current eligibility step3 for every product; pending analysis documents cannot count as supported.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Date checked only when Apply; no expiry in matcher
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Approved version with effective and expiry; re-evaluate on expiry/change; manual/AI extraction proposals reviewed before publication.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Only yes passes checked axes; untested axes ignored
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Four-state evaluation preserved; conditional/unconfirmed never mislabeled confirmed; distinguish no-match from pending clarification.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Fixed score by seed index; eligible coverage100
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Label sample percentages clearly; production formula/version + rationale + evidence coverage; no fabricated90% suitability.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Real UI threshold consumes fixed illustrative score
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Current saved requirements plus current eligible/confirmed policy; threshold preference score only after hard eligibility; verify current DD before delivery.

semanticAuditMappings.criterion: Live remaining-provider count / effect of relaxing preference
semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: No live matcher during draft; computed only submitted
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Debounced server prospective count and transparent ifpreferrednotrequired explanation; never prompt relaxing legalcontrols.
Good separation; actual per-client reporting + agreement + provider scope published; no client identity leak.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Combined results supported but serviceRules rejects bank_and_merchant
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Define how bank/merchant referral and commission components aggregate; include route or component rules without duplicate fees.

semanticAuditMappings.criterion: Private provider details to client decision
semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Result model carries score, country, rating, fee only
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Present anonymised matched product facilities, unmetpreferred needs, onboarding/limits/conditions with policy version; no confidential documents/name.

semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Many applicant fields have no ID; snapshots generic labels
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Stable semantic shared keys, route-specific object schemas and controls; no matcher parsing by labels/index/string substrings.

semanticAuditMappings.criterion: Named counterparties in DD screening scope
semanticAuditMappings.provider_fields: Screening subject records; not suitability predicate
semanticAuditMappings.current_matcher: Dossier regex counterpart.*name does not match actual field labels
semanticAuditMappings.recommended_rule: Build structured screening subjects from stable field data, not label regex; named optional counterparties must be screened and reported before introduction.

auditRowNote: 137 semantic audit mappings, not 137 individual DOM fields. Current typed criteria include automatic checks and explicit clarification holds. Legal, identity, screening and document verification are separate release gates.
